Test Case Title: Administrator - C. Add multiple inspection templates to one line
Preconditions: Logged in as Administrator. A work order line exists.
Steps to Reproduce (Manual):
As Admin, create/configure a custom role matching the 'Administrator' profile; assign it to a test user; log out and log back in as that user (fresh login so permissions load); then:
1. Log in.
2. Add an inspection template to a line.
3. Add a second and third template to the same line.
4. Attempt to add a fourth.
Expected Result:
Step 2: First inspection added ("Inspection added to line.").
Step 3: Second and third inspections added to the same line.
Step 4: VIU - spec does not state a maximum; build observed up to 3 per line. Confirm whether a 4th is prevented.
Actual Result (Observed): NOT EXECUTED. Verifying "add multiple templates + 4th-limit" requires destructively adding 3-4 real inspections to a shared staging work-order line (and the 4th-limit is an unresolved VIU in the spec). Capability confirmed: role has workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit (add is permitted).
Status Rationale: Blocked — destructive action not run on shared staging: BLOCKED reason: destructive mutation of shared staging data + spec VIU (max-per-line unspecified). Add-capability confirmed via permission. Basis: effective fe-permissions verified live via Tech quick-login (match=true vs intended); DI access is governed by these existing permissions (no dedicated DI/checklist permission exists in this org).
